lines.text: HOME is written on the spine of the cracked clear case. The name of a place, with no address.
Ren asked for this. That does not tell me whether giving it back will help.
YOU ASKED US TO KEEP THIS FROM YOU. The note was folded around the case, not hidden from its recipient.
The refusal came from Ren. I signed to take it out anyway. I should hear their answer before I decide what that means.
Released under a signed warning, for hand delivery. Keeping it in the case does not complete that promise.
I can open the cassette to hear it. Listening and returning it are separate choices.
Two separate marble eyes. A pale diagonal vein crosses one iris; a chip sits above it. The other eye is nicked low on the opposite edge.
A pair, but not interchangeable. The blind bust is where I can test the fit.
Cold mineral backs, broken away from the portrait. Water remains in the uneven edges; these are pieces of a face, not polished marbles.
Holding them will not tell me whose face they belong to. Putting them against the stone might.
The number is still on the sheet. The cassette is missing; I cannot handle it until I recover it.
Level check. / {room(take.roomId)} — recorded · recorded over an earlier entry.
No earlier take is recorded against this number. Blank stock is useful because it lets another recording survive.
One of the two sealed blanks found in B3. Its number follows the issued stock. / Issued recording stock. Its number stays the same when its contents change.
Putting a cassette within reach does not record over it. The recorder is still where I choose what to hear or replace.
